note: Planned Book of Mormon cast with period costume notes for modeling. Hand-maintained; read by tools/build_model_checklist.py. Mission codes R1-R8 are proposed missions in the Record Worlds report.

groups.name: Lehi's family and Jerusalem
groups.costumeBrief: Men: ankle-length wool or linen tunic, belted; a wool mantle with corner fringes tied with a blue cord (Numbers 15:38); a wrapped head cloth or turban with a band, as on the Lachish reliefs; full beards; leather sandals. Women: long tunic with woven bands, a mantle worn over the head, earrings, nose rings, bracelets and anklets (Isaiah 3:18–23). Colors: undyed cream and brown wool, madder red, indigo blue; purple and crimson only for the rich. Faces and builds should read as Near Eastern.

roles.name: Lehi
roles.look: About 55 to 60, grey-streaked full beard, warm and urgent. Prosperous Jerusalem tunic with a red or blue border and fringed wool mantle; travel variant in undyed wool with staff and a sun cloth over the turban.
roles.props: Staff; the Liahona, a round brass ball with two spindles (1 Nephi 16:10)

roles.name: Sariah
roles.look: About 50, strong and practical. Long tunic with embroidered bands, head mantle, a little jewelry in the city; travel variant with sun shawl and water skin.
roles.props: Water skin, grinding stone, cooking pot

roles.name: Nephi, son of Lehi
roles.look: Young man, "large in stature" (1 Nephi 2:16), short beard. Needs four costume variants: Jerusalem tunic and mantle; Laban's garments and armor (1 Nephi 4:19); desert travel; Bountiful work clothes with bare arms and a leather apron. Later, as founder of the city of Nephi (R4), a simple ruler's mantle.
roles.props: Bow (steel, then wooden), the sword of Laban, the brass plates, tools

roles.name: Laman
roles.look: Eldest brother. Check the existing model against Judean tunic, mantle and turban; add a desert travel variant.

roles.name: Lemuel
roles.look: Check the existing model as for Laman; give him a different silhouette (lighter build, different mantle color).

roles.name: Sam
roles.look: About 20, short beard, steady. Knee-length work tunic, belt, sling at the waist.

roles.name: Zoram
roles.look: Young servant of Laban in good linen, with the treasury keys on his belt. Later travels with the family in plain wool.

roles.name: Laban
roles.look: Commander of fifty and keeper of the plates (1 Nephi 3:31). Bronze scale coat over a fine tunic, rich mantle, officer's headdress. Shown in the earlier attempts; his death stays an off-screen, authored account.
roles.props: Sword with a gold hilt and fine steel blade (1 Nephi 4:9), the brass plates

roles.name: Ishmael
roles.look: Elderly head of a large household, white beard, fine but older-fashioned mantle. Needs a burial-shroud variant for Nahom.

roles.name: Ishmael's wife
roles.look: Elderly matriarch; dark head mantle, many bracelets.

roles.name: Nephi's wife, a daughter of Ishmael
roles.look: Unnamed in the text (label the name as adapted if one is used). Young woman; colored tunic and head mantle; later a mother with infants in the wilderness.

roles.name: Ishmael's other daughters
roles.look: Four variants with different mantle colors and hair; married to Laman, Lemuel, Sam and Zoram.

roles.name: Ishmael's sons
roles.look: Two adult men with their households (1 Nephi 7:6), Judean dress.

roles.name: Jacob, younger brother
roles.look: Child born in the wilderness, about 6 to 8 at the shipyard; simple short tunic.

roles.name: Joseph, younger brother
roles.look: Younger child, about 4 to 6; short tunic.

roles.name: Jerusalem townsman
roles.look: Four variants (young, middle, old, laborer) in tunic, mantle and head cloth.

roles.name: Jerusalem townswoman
roles.look: Four variants; head mantle, jars carried on the head or hip.

roles.name: Levite or temple priest
roles.look: White linen tunic with sash and linen cap.

roles.name: Scribe
roles.look: Linen tunic, ink case at the belt (Ezekiel 9:2).

roles.name: Merchant or potter
roles.look: Rolled sleeves, apron; variants for potter and cloth seller.

roles.name: Judean soldier and Laban's guard
roles.look: As on the Lachish reliefs: short tunic, headband with ear flaps or a pointed helmet, scale coat for officers, round shield, spear, short sword.

roles.name: Jerusalem child
roles.look: Boy and girl in short tunics.

roles.name: Shepherd
roles.look: Short tunic, sheepskin cloak, sling and staff.

groups.name: The Arabian road
groups.era: Red Sea coast to Dhofar, about 600 to 590 BC
groups.costumeBrief: Lehi's family keep Judean dress but it becomes worn, sun-faded and layered: head cloths wrapped against sun and sand, cloaks used as bedding, bows and quivers, water skins. Local people dress in the South Arabian way seen on Sabaean statues: men in knee-length wrap skirts with a belt and curved dagger, long hair or braids, cloaks; women in long dresses and veils. Camel caravans carry frankincense.

roles.name: Arabian herder, man and woman
roles.look: Goat-hair cloaks, wrap skirts, head cloths; dark sun-weathered faces.

roles.name: South Arabian caravan trader
roles.look: Sabaean-style wrap skirt, belt with curved dagger, long braided hair, mantle; camel driver variant.

roles.name: Tribal elder near Nahom
roles.look: Optional. Heavier mantle, staff, tribal ornaments.

groups.name: The Jaredites
groups.era: The tower era, an ancient Near Eastern setting with no fixed date
groups.costumeBrief: Use early Mesopotamian dress: tufted fleece kaunakes skirts or fringed wool shawls wrapped over one shoulder, long beards, long hair bound with a fillet, bare feet or simple sandals. Women in long fringed wraps with hair in nets or coils. Keep it visibly older and stranger than Lehi's Judah.

roles.name: The brother of Jared
roles.look: Strong, older craftsman with a long beard and fringed shawl over one shoulder; work variant with leather apron for the barges and the smelting of the stones.

roles.name: Jared
roles.look: Brother of similar age, finer fringed shawl, a family leader rather than a craftsman.

roles.name: Jaredite families
roles.look: Men, women and children in kaunakes and wraps; barge builders and herders.

groups.name: Nephites and Lamanites, named
groups.era: Mesoamerica, about 550 BC to AD 421 (Preclassic to Early Classic)
groups.costumeBrief: Base dress: men wear a loincloth with a hip cloth and a cotton mantle knotted at one shoulder, leather or fiber sandals, headbands or wrapped headdresses, jade or shell ear ornaments. Women wear a wrap skirt with a blouse or shoulder cape, a shawl, and long hair with woven ribbons. Elites add quetzal and macaw feather headdresses, jaguar pelts, jade, shell, pyrite mirrors and red-dyed cloth. Warriors wear quilted cotton armor ("thick clothing"), breastplates, arm shields and head plates (Alma 43:19–21). Draw Nephites and Lamanites as Indigenous Mesoamerican peoples who differ in dress, heraldry and region, never in skin tone. The first Nephite generations (Enos, Jacob) can keep Old World touches such as the fringed mantle.

roles.name: Enos
roles.look: Highland hunter, about 30; first-generation Nephite mixing a fringed mantle with local cotton and sandals; bow and quiver.

roles.name: King Benjamin
roles.look: Aged king who labored with his own hands (Mosiah 2:14): plain white cotton mantle with a woven border, modest jade, no feather crown.
roles.props: The sword of Laban (Words of Mormon 1:13), the plates

roles.name: King Noah
roles.look: Heavy and lavish: quetzal-feather headdress, jaguar pelt over the shoulders, red mantle, gold and jade at the neck and wrists, as in the Friberg painting of Abinadi.

roles.name: Noah's priests, with Amulon
roles.look: Five or six variants on ornate seats: rich cotton robes, red headbands, feather and jade ornaments; Amulon as a named lead.

roles.name: Abinadi
roles.look: Old man, white beard, lean; arrives disguised in coarse clothes (Mosiah 12:1); bound with cords in the court.

roles.name: Alma the Elder
roles.look: Young priest of Noah in court finery, then a stripped-down refugee in plain cotton; older father in BM12.

roles.name: Alma the Younger
roles.look: Check the existing model against Nephite elite dress; needs a proud young variant and a later plain-mantle preacher variant.

roles.name: Ammon, son of Mosiah
roles.look: Nephite prince serving as a Lamanite king's herdsman: plain servant's loincloth and mantle, sling, sword.

roles.name: Lamoni
roles.look: Lamanite king of the land of Ishmael: royal Lamanite heraldry, feather crest, jade, fine cotton.

roles.name: Lamoni's queen
roles.look: Royal woman in fine embroidered blouse and wrap skirt, jade collar, feathered hair ornament.

roles.name: Abish
roles.look: Lamanite servant woman with agency and voice: work wrap skirt and blouse, hair bound back, a simple shell necklace.

roles.name: Lamoni's father, king over all the land
roles.look: Optional. Older Lamanite high king, heavier regalia than Lamoni.

roles.name: Anti-Nephi-Lehi, the king
roles.look: Optional. Lamoni's brother, king at the covenant; regalia set aside at the burial of weapons.

roles.name: Amulek
roles.look: Wealthy Ammonihah citizen: costly cotton mantle, then plain preacher's clothes; bound in prison.

roles.name: Zeezrom
roles.look: Ammonihah lawyer in costly apparel, later fevered and humbled.

roles.name: Chief judge of Ammonihah
roles.look: Order of Nehor elite: costly apparel, feathered staff of office.

roles.name: Captain Moroni
roles.look: Chief captain at 25: breastplate, arm shields, head plate and quilted cotton armor; commander's cape.
roles.props: The title of liberty, a rent coat on a pole (Alma 46:12–13)

roles.name: Lehi, commander at Noah
roles.look: Nephite officer in heavy armor, distinct crest from Moroni.

roles.name: Teancum
roles.look: Night raider: dark cotton, light armor, face unpainted; a servant at his side.

roles.name: Amalickiah
roles.look: Nephite dissenter made Lamanite king: royal regalia, appears asleep in his tent on night one.

roles.name: Ammoron
roles.look: Amalickiah's brother and successor; royal war tent and regalia, night two.

roles.name: Helaman, military and religious leader
roles.look: Prophet and commander: armor over a priest's white mantle.

roles.name: Antipus
roles.look: Nephite commander of the city of Judea, worn by long war.

roles.name: Nephi, son of Helaman
roles.look: Missionary brother in plain travel cotton; Nephite, in a Lamanite prison.

roles.name: Lehi, son of Helaman
roles.look: Younger brother, same plain dress with a different mantle color.

roles.name: Aminadab
roles.look: Nephite-born dissenter living among the Lamanites; Lamanite dress with an older Nephite ornament.

roles.name: Samuel the Lamanite
roles.look: Lamanite prophet; Friberg shows a red cape and bare chest on the wall. Give him Lamanite regional dress, sandals and a headband; no armor.

roles.name: Lachoneus
roles.look: Nephite chief judge and governor during the Gadianton war.

roles.name: Gidgiddoni
roles.look: Nephite chief captain and prophet; heavy armor.

roles.name: Giddianhi and Zemnarihah
roles.look: Gadianton leaders; see the robber costume below, with leader ornaments.

roles.name: Nephi, chief of the twelve disciples
roles.look: Survivor of the destruction, then disciple: plain white cotton mantle.

roles.name: The twelve disciples
roles.look: Eleven more variants of age and build in plain cotton mantles.

roles.name: Mormon
roles.look: "Large in stature" (Mormon 2:1), about 74 at Cumorah: weathered commander's armor, wounded variant.

roles.name: Moroni, mortal record keeper
roles.look: Warrior at Cumorah, then a lone wanderer for 36 years: cloak growing more patched, furs added as he walks north into snow. Different from the resurrected Moroni model used in chapters 04 to 10.

roles.name: The angel in Alma's account
roles.look: Luminous figure; keep human and dignified, no wings.

roles.name: Lamanite commanders
roles.look: Generic war leaders with crested helmets, feather standards and heavy armor.

groups.name: Mesoamerican crowds and residents
groups.era: For Zarahemla, the land of Nephi, Bountiful and the war frontier
groups.costumeBrief: Build these as kits with interchangeable mantles, headdresses, jewelry and colors, so 10 to 15 bodies produce hundreds of residents. Ages: child, youth, adult, elder. Use the cotton, feather and jade language above, with hair in topknots, braids or wrapped turbans.

roles.name: Farmer, man and woman
roles.look: Loincloth and short mantle; wrap skirt and blouse; straw-brimmed sun cloths.

roles.name: Mother with infant
roles.look: Shawl tied as a baby carrier, wrap skirt.

roles.name: Elder, man and woman
roles.look: Heavier mantles, canes, grey hair.

roles.name: Children
roles.look: Boys and girls, ages 4 to 12; small loincloths and wraps.

roles.name: Porter with tumpline
roles.look: Strap across the forehead holding a carrying frame; a strong signature silhouette.

roles.name: Weaver
roles.look: Kneeling woman at a backstrap loom.

roles.name: Potter
roles.look: Clay-stained apron cloth.

roles.name: Mason and plasterer
roles.look: Lime-whitened skin and loincloth, as in The Testaments building scene.

roles.name: Lime burner
roles.look: Soot and ash marks, head cloth.

roles.name: Obsidian knapper
roles.look: Leather lap pad, seated.

roles.name: Jade carver and featherworker
roles.look: Fine cotton, elite workshop servant.

roles.name: Scribe
roles.look: White mantle, headband with a brush tucked in.

roles.name: Market vendor
roles.look: Seated vendors on mats; cacao, cotton, salt, fish.

roles.name: Fisher and canoe man
roles.look: Loincloth, head cloth, wet skin.

roles.name: Hunter
roles.look: Deer-hide cape, bow.

roles.name: Herdsman of the king's flocks
roles.look: Lamanite servant dress with sling.

roles.name: Noble, man and woman
roles.look: Feather headdresses, jade collars, embroidered mantles; late 4 Nephi variant with "costly apparel" and pearls (4 Nephi 1:24).

roles.name: Court guard
roles.look: Spear, quilted vest, feather crest.

roles.name: Temple attendant
roles.look: White or dark mantle, copal incense.

roles.name: Musician
roles.look: Conch trumpet, wooden drum, clay flute players.

roles.name: Nephite soldier
roles.look: Light (sling or bow, cotton vest) and heavy (breastplate, arm shields, head plate) variants (Alma 43:19).
roles.props: Sling, bow, spear, obsidian-edged sword, round shield

roles.name: Lamanite warrior
roles.look: Early-war variant from Alma 3:5 (shaved head, leather loin garment, bow) and a later armored variant (Alma 49:6). Dignified, not savage.
roles.props: Bow, sling, club, shield, feather standard

roles.name: Helaman's young soldiers
roles.look: Youths of 16 to 20 in plain quilted cotton armor; at least six face and build variants.

roles.name: Gadianton robber
roles.look: Lamb skin dyed in blood about the loins, shorn heads covered with head plates (3 Nephi 4:7).

roles.name: Wounded and caregivers
roles.look: Bandaged soldiers and caregivers in plain cotton.

roles.name: Survivors of the destruction
roles.look: Ash-dusted, torn clothing, families clinging together.

roles.name: Settlers of Nephi's first city
roles.look: Second-generation family dress mixing Judean mantles with local cotton.
